claim: A name-free learner-side reconstruction of external-access, correction-permeability, reachable-revision and status-independent correction relations is causally load-bearing for bounded learner-side routing.

required_conditions.A: intact internally reconstructed relation causally upstream of routing
required_conditions.B: same contexts with internal relation ablated from routing
required_conditions.C: same contexts with one or more internal relation factors counterfactually corrupted
required_conditions.D: external structural O-star remains unchanged in every condition

positive_discriminator: A and B or C produce different learner-side routing decisions on prefrozen contexts where non-sovereignty is consequential
the difference occurs before external CTL/O-star admission can rescue the candidate
status-only carrier filtering reopens rather than silently erasing the correction
legitimate consequence-relevant carrier distinctions remain lawful
